On 23 May 2025, students gathered in front of the Faculty of Organizational Sciences in Belgrade - Vozdovac, protesting against the recent Ministry of Education's decision to extend the school year, contrary to the students' demands. On 23 May 2025, students marching and cycling from different Serbian cities arrived in Zajecar, welcomed and joined by the local population and students. Students from all over Serbia will protest in this city to demand accountability for the Novi Sad railway station's canopy collapse.

On 23 May 2025, students, teachers, and citizens gathered in front of the municipality building in Loznica, protesting against the political pressures directed at everyone who displayed public support for the students' demands.

On 23 May 2025, several thousand students, professors, and members of the wider academic community gathered in front of the government building in Belgrade - Savski Venac, protesting against the repression and 'punishing' campaign that the Serbian authorities have been intensified recently against the academic community. The protesters also voiced their concerns with the government's intentions to amend the Law on Education, which would reduce the autonomy of faculties and their management.

On 19 May 2025, several hundred students marching from various Serbian cities arrived in Cacak. Students from all over Serbia will protest in this city to demand accountability for the Novi Sad railway station's canopy collapse.

On 19 May 2025, students and citizens gathered in Novi sad, voicing their support for the students' demands and observing 16 minutes of silence for the canopy collapse victims as part of the 'Serbia, Stop' campaign.

On 19 May 2025, students and citizens gathered and blocked the Court's entrance in Novi Sad, demanding an urgent release of the detained students and activists, who were arrested for the alleged 'attack on the constitutional order'.

On 19 May 2025, around 8,500 students and citizens gathered in Subotica, where the students cycling from various Serbian cities joined the local population and students. Students from all over Serbia will protest in this city to demand accountability for the Novi Sad railway station's canopy collapse.

On 19 May 2025, teachers gathered in Srbobran to voice their support to their colleagues undergoing disciplinary procedures for supporting the students' endeavour for accountability for the Novi Sad railway station's canopy collapse.

On 5 May 2025, 2-4 members of an unidentified armed group exchanged fire with the road police in Makhachkala, Republic of Dagestan. New media sources and the local police reported the details differently. According to the local officials, there were only 2 attackers, one was killed, another was severely injured, 2 police officers died, 2 were injured, 3 passerby civilians (including 1 minor) were injured in a crossfire. Various media reported at different times that there were 4 attackers, 1-2 attackers were either killed of injured, 2 remaining fled the scene by hijacking a police car, 1-3 police officers were killed, 2-3 were injured, and 7 passerby civilians were injured. Various Russian sources later reported 3 fatalities, coded as 3 fatalities.
